title: Mishnah Bikkurim
attributionNote: Traditionally compiled by Rabbi Judah ha-Nasi from earlier rabbinic traditions. The Mishnah is a composite legal corpus, not a single-author book.
description: First fruits and grains ceremoniously brought to the Temple and given to a priest next to the altar. The complete tractate is imported in Hebrew and, where available, in the William Davidson English translation.
historicalContext: The Mishnah is the foundational compilation of rabbinic oral law, arranged in six sedarim. It is authoritative in traditional Judaism but is not part of the Tanakh.
